primary.poolable_reason: SAME TWO TRIALS AS SOTATERCEPT_PAH_AUTO_FULL_REVIEW, AND THE SAME VERDICT. This page seeds NCT03496207 and NCT04896008 -- exactly the pair carried by the other sotatercept topic, closed on 2026-08-18. Both test sotatercept against placebo in pulmonary arterial hypertension, and their registered primaries are different KINDS of quantity: 'Change From Baseline in Pulmonary Vascular Resistance (PVR) at 24 Weeks' -- a continuous haemodynamic measurement -- against 'Time to First Confirmed Morbidity or Mortality Event', a time-to-event clinical composite. No conversion between them is supported by either registration. AND THE DUPLICATION IS ITSELF WORTH RECORDING: two cardiology topics carry the same two trials under different titles. That is a topic-list question and is flagged for Mahmood rather than resolved here.

primary.what_this_verdict_does_not_establish: NOT that any trial here is poor. NOT that the drug is ineffective. NOT that no poolable question exists in this area -- only that this page cannot answer the one its title asks. If a further eligible trial is identified, this verdict should be revisited.
